title: Meta-schema for a Connector command document
description: Every file in protocol/commands/ is validated against this, which is what makes the allowlist a testable artifact rather than a list in a document (ADR-0007). Both the Go switch and the TypeScript client are tested against these documents in Phase 2.

class.description: read = no state change; converge = drive toward desired state, repeated calls are no-ops; replace = declarative replace-and-reconcile; mutate = creates or changes a stored entity; probe = measures something, results are inherently time-varying.

idempotent.description: If true, envelope.id is the idempotency key and a replayed request returns the stored response (ADR-0008).

replayable.description: False for probes: timings and live results must not be served from an idempotency cache. The client MUST mark such a replayed value stale.

timeoutMs.description: Owned by the caller. A hung host must never hang the service worker.

requiresHello.description: True when the Connector must refuse this method until connector.hello has succeeded. MUST be the exact complement of protocol/command-allowlist.json#/commands[availableBeforeHello] for the same name; scripts/verify.mjs asserts both directions, because a method the allowlist dispatches pre-hello while its own doc demands hello is a negotiation deadlock -- connector.hello itself is the only such method.

capabilities.description: Capability names from protocol/compatibility-rules.json. Empty means always available once hello succeeds.

errors.description: Subset of protocol/error-taxonomy.json codes this command can return. Checked by scripts/verify.mjs.

progressEvents.description: Event names from events.schema.json emitted while this command runs.

nonIdempotencyRationale.description: Required by scripts/verify.mjs whenever idempotent is false.

invariants.description: Testable statements about this command. Each must have a row in docs/verification/live-matrix.md, otherwise it is a claim nothing checks.
